name.description: Unique identifier using lowercase letters and hyphens

description.description: When Claude should delegate to this subagent

tools.description: Tools the subagent can use (inherits all tools if omitted)

disallowedTools.description: Tools to deny, removed from inherited or specified list

model.description: Model to use: aliases (sonnet, opus, haiku, inherit) or full model IDs (e.g. claude-opus-4-6)

skills.description: Skills to load into the subagent's context at startup

mcpServers.description: MCP servers available to this agent. Each entry is either a string reference to a configured server or an inline definition object.

oneOf.description: Name of an already-configured MCP server
Inline MCP server definition keyed by server name

effort.description: Effort level when this agent is active. Overrides the session effort level. Options: low, medium, high, max (Opus 4.6 only).

color.description: claudelint extension: Display color for the agent in the UI (not in official Claude Code docs, but used by /agents UI color picker)

background.description: Set to true to always run this subagent as a background task

isolation.description: Set to 'worktree' to run the subagent in a temporary git worktree

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks scoped to this subagent, keyed by event name (e.g. PreToolUse, PostToolUse)
